status: PHASE 3C LONGITUDINAL STABILITY VALIDATION / TAIL-VOLUME TRADE / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION OR FLIGHT CLEARANCE

design_review.note: This is a screening target only. It is not a flight-safety or certification limit and is not itself an acceptance gate.

boundary: Phase 3C first validates the Phase 3B static-margin magnitude and moment-reference convention before using it for sizing.
The tail-volume grid varies only horizontal-tail area and aerodynamic-center station using the lowest-static-margin Phase 3B planform family member as a comparison shape.
No Phase 3C case is promoted to config/he1_baseline.json by this analysis.
The 8-20% MAC range is a provisional design-review band, not an airworthiness or flight-test acceptance criterion.
The model remains main wing plus horizontal tail only; fuselage, vertical tail, elevator, propeller slipstream, viscous profile drag, aeroelastic deformation and structural effects remain excluded.
Trim and elevator authority must be analyzed after a longitudinal stability region is identified.
